summary:
Comprehensive guide explaining:
1. Where data is stored (MySQL database 'voting_system' on localhost:3306)
2. All database tables and what they store
3. Three methods to view the data (MySQL CLI, MySQL Workbench, Prisma Studio)
4. Complete step-by-step code flow when clicking '+ New Election' — from the React button click through API call, server routing, authentication, controller logic, repository, Prisma ORM, to the MySQL INSERT query and back
5. Architecture diagram showing the 3-layer system (Browser → Server → Database)
6. Quick reference table of all key files
